decks.notes: This deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature-based gameplay with a heavy emphasis on dealing damage quickly to the opponent. It utilizes low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, along with spells like Infuriate and Reckless Rage, to push through damage and control the board. The deck also includes cards like Claim / Fame and Turn Inside Out to provide flexibility and additional ways to deal damage. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive game plan, allowing for consistent and powerful plays throughout the game.

The strategy of this Dimir Control deck revolves around utilizing powerful threats and disruption spells to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By constantly disrupting their opponent's plans with cards like Thoughtseize and Narset, Parter of Veils, while also having a variety of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to grind out the opponent and overwhelm them with card advantage and efficient threats like Tinybones Joins Up and The Meathook Massacre. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion gives the deck additional value and flexibility in the late game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from exile for repeated attacks. The deck includes a mix of spells that can help you draw cards and find your Phoenixes, as well as removal and countermagic to protect your creatures. The inclusion of cards like Temporal Trespass and Picklock Prankster adds extra value and versatility to the deck, making it a fast and aggressive option for Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells. The focus is on dealing damage quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger, Heartfire Hero, and Monstrous Rage to keep up the pressure. The inclusion of cards like Screaming Nemesis and Soul-Scar Mage helps to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also benefits from mana acceleration with cards like Innkeeper's Talent and efficient land choices to ensure a smooth curve of aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board while draining the opponent's resources. By utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce, along with efficient removal like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. Creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Mockingbird provide additional pressure, while cards like Enduring Curiosity and Faerie Miscreant help maintain card advantage. The deck also includes utility lands like Mutavault and Watery Grave to ensure consistent mana production.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and disruptive tactics to outlast the opponent and establish dominance on the battlefield. It aims to control the game by removing threats, disrupting the opponent's hand, and generating card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the control game plan and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana. Overall, the deck seeks to grind out victories through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help maintain pressure on the opponent, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat keep the opponent's board in check. By combining efficient creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to close out games swiftly before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Duress provide additional disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, this deck aims to win through sheer aggression and disruption.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy, utilizing cheap, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, along with pump spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage to deal fast and efficient damage. The deck also includes some burn spells like Slickshot Show-Off and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to finish off opponents or clear the way for attacks. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach and late-game potential, ensuring the deck can close out games quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Human creatures. Cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar boost the power of the board, while cards like Reflector Mage provide tempo by bouncing key threats back to the opponent's hand. The inclusion of protection cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Get Lost help to protect key creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base includes lands like Mutavault and Cavern of Souls to ensure a smooth curve and consistent mana fixing for the Human tribal theme.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, aiming to quickly reduce their life total to zero. The deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and removal spells to maintain pressure on the opponent while generating value through cards like Innkeeper's Talent and Monstrous Rage. By combining creatures like Manifold Mouse and Emberheart Challenger with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, this Gruul Aggro deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck utilizes Niv-Mizzet Reborn as its central card, aiming to control the game by using a variety of cards to answer threats and generate card advantage. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in accessing different cards as needed. The deck also includes various triomes and other lands to help fix mana, ensuring consistent access to all colors. Vanishing Verse and Leyline Binding provide removal options, while companions such as Yorion, Sky Nomad offer additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of control elements and card advantage.

The focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by utilizing powerful control spells and removal, while also generating card advantage through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Tinybones Joins Up. The deck aims to control the board through cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, while also utilizing The Meathook Massacre as a win condition. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and a more flexible game plan. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy and provide consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also aims to apply pressure with evasive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Faerie Mastermind. By combining disruption, control, and aggression, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and come out ahead in a one-on-one Pioneer game.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent by disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize, utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils, and removal spells like Fatal Push. It aims to outvalue the opponent with card advantage from Narset and Omen of the Sea, while also generating incremental advantage with the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck is designed to outlast the opponent through attrition, making it difficult for them to establish a presence on the board and ultimately winning through efficient removal and powerful threats.

This Aggro deck focuses on utilizing Spirit creatures to quickly apply pressure on opponents while maintaining tempo control through bounce effects and disruption. The key strategy involves playing aggressive creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom to chip away at the opponent's life total while countering key spells with Spell Queller and disruption with Skyclave Apparition. With a mix of aggressive creatures, disruptive spells, and land versatility, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful synergy. By controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, as well as disruptive cards like Duress, the deck aims to set up its combo pieces while keeping the opponent in check. With additional threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck can apply pressure on multiple fronts. The mana base is constructed to support the deck's color requirements and keep it running smoothly.
